title: Question-unit split for one paper (papers/_work/<paperId>/split.json)
description: Gen-3 metadata-first SPLIT contract. The unit boundaries are truth; the per-question PDF is a deterministic bake of this. bbox is normalised 0-1 per page (top-left origin), so a unit is resolution-independent and scores directly against annotate_app boxes. A unit may span pages via multiple regions.

id.description: Stable unit id, e.g. 'q14' or booklet letter 'q11a'.

part.description: Lettered part when a >=10-mark booklet was split per letter; else null.

section.description: Section name from syllabus.json (e.g. 'I', 'II') this unit falls in.

ruleId.description: Audit: the SPLIT rule that produced this unit (S1 whole-question, S2 booklet-split, ...). Lets regressions diff by rule.
